dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i me ro dgung na mngon par mtho ba 'bar bar mdzad pa'i byed po/'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srol gto

tei:div.tei:p: dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i me ro dgung na mngon par mtho ba 'bar bar mdzad pa'i byed po/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srol gtod chen po 'bri gung 7skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan ltar bsam bzhin du mi yi skye ba bzhes pa rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen (shing lug 1475 me phag 1527)ni/ dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa nyams dmas kyi skabs su byon te/ gang gi mngon par byang chub pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba'i mthu las/ chad la khad pa'i 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi chos brgyud rnams dpal stag lung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po ngag dbang grags pa sogs las nod de dar spel dang*/ yig mkhan mkhas pa brgya phrag kha shas nas snga rjes su rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog rnams dang*/ bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum sogs gser dngul gyi rgyu las bzhengs te tshogs gnyis kyi mjings las rol pa'i lo rgyus rnams 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi gdan rabs gser 'phreng dang*/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen nyid kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa rnams su zhib tu gsal/ da lam ma phyi gser chos pod bzhi can dang*/ kha 'thor bris rnying pod gnyis rnyed son byung ba phyogs sgrig gis chos tshan go rim sgrig stangs ma phyi dang mi 'dra bar rnam thar dang rgyu+ud sde'i skor/ dgongs gcig dang bstan snying skor/ zhus lan dang sgrub thabs skor sogs dbye ba phyes te bzhag pa 'tshol bde'i khyad chos dang*/ pod rer ldeb sum brgya gzhir bzhag byas pa legs tshogs che/ zhu dag skabs sngags yig rnams kun mkhyen chos grags kyi gsung 'bum ji bzhin dang*/ gzhan brda rnying dang*/ yul skad lta bu go dka' ba rnams ma bcos par rang sor bzhag cing*/ phag mo'i cho ga dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i dbang bskur skabs/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang 'khrugs pa rnams bka' brgyud sngags mdzod nang bzhugs dpa' bo gtsug phreng gi lhan cig skyes ma'i dkyil chog gsang chen myur lam la khungs bcol te/

'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi mkhas dbang rnam par bcar 'dri zhus te bsgrigs pa dang*/ rgyal dbang kun dga'i rnam thar snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen mor don rgyan 'ga' zhig ngos 'dzin gsal kha med pa phal cher lugs gzhan nam/ dgongs pa can yin srid pas ma dpe gzhir bzhag byas pa bcas las rim 'di bzhin ldi li 'bri gung bka' brgyud gsung rab nyams gso khang nas mthun 'gyur cha rkyen 'og rang grwa karma 'gyur med dang*/ dkon mchog don grub gnyis kyis par rtsa rig mdzod nang gsar du bcug te/ zhu dag thengs bdun tsam mgon po rdo rje dang*/ 'brong ngur skal bzang chos 'phel gnyis kyis bgyis/ gzhan dpe gzugs dang*/ dbu lha'i bkod pa/ chos tshan gyi go rim dang tha ma'i zhu dag sogs 'brong ngur skal bzang chos 'phel gyis zhus shing*/ par bskrun gyi las don rnams yo red brtson 'grus seng ges bsgrubs pa bcas rnam dkar gyi bya ba rgya chen po 'di nyid la rgyu sbyor yon bdag dang*/ 'di'i thad 'brel thog rnams tshe lhag don ldan bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod cing*/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen go 'phang mchog la gegs med myur du reg pa'i smon 'dun gyis mtshams sbyar te 7rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang phrin las lhun grub kyis spyi lo 2002 zla 11 tshes bzang por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //
